_doc: Resemblyzer GE2E embeddings of the S1 voice-over voices, for twin scenarios without torch. profiles = mean of all 2 s windows of each household member (so 'utterances' overlap the profile data and score optimistically). replay = Bluetooth-speaker replay proxy of the same windows. Generated by experiments/speaker_id/run.py.

threshold.why: the hub hears people through a room, so thresholds calibrated on the room channel apply; 'strict' (FAR<=1 % on these trials) because attributing a request to the wrong person is worse than asking
